$comment: The API returns a stable reason_code and never a message a patient reads
directly (§28). This bundle is the only place a reason_code becomes words, so
a patient never sees a technical string, and every failure has a defined
next action rather than a dead end (§37).
Each entry has: title, body, action (what the button says), and staff (whether
a staff member should be called).

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Nothing you have told us is lost. Please try once more.

authentication_required.title: This session has ended
authentication_required.body: For your privacy, this screen was cleared. Please start again from the beginning.

forbidden.title: This is not available here
forbidden.body: Please ask a staff member for help.

not_found.title: We could not find that
not_found.body: Please ask a staff member for help.

conflict.title: That has already been done
conflict.body: You can carry on from here.

validation_failed.title: Please check your answer
validation_failed.body: That answer does not look complete. Please try again.

consent_required.title: We need your permission first
consent_required.body: We cannot continue without your permission. A staff member can take your details in person instead.

session_sealed_after_export.title: The doctor has already finalised this
session_sealed_after_export.body: Your record has been sent to the doctor and can no longer be changed here. Please tell the doctor directly.

dependency_unavailable.title: One part of the system is slow
dependency_unavailable.body: You can carry on. Nothing you have told us is lost.

rate_limited.title: Please wait a moment
rate_limited.body: That was a little too fast. Please wait a few seconds and try again.

payload_too_large.title: That file is too large
payload_too_large.body: Please take the photograph again, or ask a staff member to help.

unsupported_media_type.title: We cannot read that kind of file
unsupported_media_type.body: Please take a photograph of the paper instead.

device_not_provisioned.title: This screen is not set up
device_not_provisioned.body: Please tell a staff member that this kiosk needs to be set up.

token_expired.title: The time has run out
token_expired.body: For your safety, the code has expired. Please start that step again.

invalid_signature.title: This link is not valid
invalid_signature.body: Please scan the code shown on the kiosk screen again.

wrong_token_kind.title: This link is not valid
wrong_token_kind.body: Please scan the code shown on the kiosk screen again.

upload_session_closed.title: This has already finished
upload_session_closed.body: Your visit details have already been sent to the doctor. Please show your papers to the doctor directly.

malware_detected.title: We could not accept that file
malware_detected.body: Please take a photograph of the paper with the camera instead.

image_unreadable.title: The photograph is not clear
image_unreadable.body: Hold the paper flat, keep it in the light, and take the photograph again.

asr_unavailable.title: Voice is not working right now
asr_unavailable.body: Please answer by touching the screen. Everything you have said so far is saved.

asr_low_confidence.title: I did not catch that clearly
asr_low_confidence.body: It is noisy here. Please say it again, or answer by touching the screen.

unknown_option.title: Please choose from the options shown
unknown_option.body: Touch one of the choices on the screen.

exclusive_option_conflict.title: That cannot be combined
exclusive_option_conflict.body: You chose 'none of these' along with other answers. Please choose one or the other.

out_of_range.title: Please check that number
out_of_range.body: That number seems too high or too low. Please enter it again.

value_required.title: Please answer this one
value_required.body: This question needs an answer. If you do not know, touch 'I do not know'.

expected_number.title: Please enter a number
expected_number.body: Use the number buttons on the screen.

expected_date.title: Please choose a date
expected_date.body: Use the date picker on the screen.

too_long.title: That is a little too long
too_long.body: Please shorten it, or tell the doctor directly instead.

caregiver_ack_required.title: We must ask the patient first
caregiver_ack_required.body: Before you answer for the patient, the patient must tell us it is all right.

caregiver_cannot_grant_consent.title: A staff member must record this
caregiver_cannot_grant_consent.body: Permission on someone else's behalf needs a document and a staff member. Please go to the counter.

offline_queued.title: Saved on this screen
offline_queued.body: The internet is not working. Your answer is saved here and will be sent automatically.
